title: DunkEvent
description: Wire format for a server-scored dunk attempt in the FEL Basketball Dunk Contest. Every field is required for a valid, auditable replay.

match_id.description: Unique match identifier, issued by POST /api/matches/create

seed.description: 64-bit non-repeating integer generated by os.urandom at match creation. Drives all judge offsets deterministically.

player_inputs.description: Raw inputs captured from the iOS client during the dunk attempt. These are the ONLY client-side values accepted; scoring is server-authoritative.

launch_angle.description: Normalised launch quality (0.0 = worst, 1.0 = perfect). Maps to approach_quality in the scoring engine.

trick_sequence_hash.description: 8-hex-char CRC32 of the ordered trick ID sequence selected by the player. Used to derive style_difficulty and validate the trick combo on the server.

landing_precision.description: Normalised landing quality (0.0 = stumbled, 1.0 = stuck). Maps to execution_quality in the scoring engine.

style_key.description: Human-readable style ID for the selected dunk. Used alongside trick_sequence_hash for server-side style_difficulty lookup.

judge_offsets.description: Three deterministic offsets derived from seed via derive_judge_offsets(seed). Fixed for the lifetime of the match.

result.description: Server-computed scoring result. Client MUST NOT calculate these values.

message.description: Human-readable verdict. PERFECT SCORE requires total >= 28 AND all judges >= 9.

is_perfect.description: True iff total >= 28 and j1 >= 9 and j2 >= 9 and j3 >= 9

verification_hash.description: Optional SHA-256(seed + canonical_events_json). Present on export-replay and ghost publish payloads.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the server scored this attempt

event_type.description: Event type discriminator for the match event log
